message.reasoning_content: Rain: only Ringo lead. I Wanna Be Your Man: Ringo and Brian Jones... Beatles version Ringo only lead? Yes Ringo sang it. But "Rain" – Ringo only. Hmm, "I Wanna Be Your Man" Ringo sings, all vocals Ringo. Both? "Rain" is commonly the answer—only song with Ringo as sole lead? Actually Rain has tambourine... Beatles songs with Ringo solo lead: Yellow Submarine, With a Little Help, Boys, Act Naturally, Good Night, Octopus's Garden, Honey Don't, Matchbox, I Wanna Be Your Man, Rain? Rain: Ringo only lead vocal. Both qualify. Ringo famously cited Rain as best drumming; "only lead singer" maybe excludes I Wanna Be Your Man because Ringo and John sang? No, John and Paul sang backing... Actually "Boys" backings. Choose Rain? I Wanna Be Your Man — Ringo only lead, John/Paul backing. Rain also. Answer Rain, prob ~0.6? Hmm. The distinguishing: She Came In Through Bathroom Window is trio; Looking Through You is Paul. Between Rain and I Wanna Be Your Man — Rain is often cited as the only Beatles song with Ringo solo lead? No, many. I'll pick Rain, 0.65.
